summary: Universal type system providing TypeSpec/FieldSpec for schema metadata, UniversalType enum for cross-backend type mapping, extraction from DataFrames/dataclasses/Pydantic, validation, Frictionless Table Schema import/export, DataPackage/DataResource/TableDialect container types, and custom type registry.

key_classes.name: TypeSpec
key_classes.purpose: Backend-agnostic schema specification with fields, constraints, primary keys

key_classes.name: FieldSpec
key_classes.purpose: Per-field metadata: name, type, constraints, Frictionless properties

key_classes.name: FieldConstraints
key_classes.purpose: Field-level constraints: required, unique, enum, min/max

key_classes.name: UniversalType
key_classes.purpose: Enum bridging Mountainash types to Polars/Pandas/Arrow/Ibis native types

key_classes.name: DataResource
key_classes.purpose: Frictionless Data Resource with path, schema, dialect, format

key_classes.name: CustomTypeRegistry
key_classes.purpose: Registry for semantic type converters beyond built-in types

key_functions.name: extract_from_dataframe
key_functions.purpose: Infer TypeSpec from a DataFrame's column types

key_functions.name: extract_from_dataclass
key_functions.purpose: Build TypeSpec from Python dataclass fields

key_functions.name: extract_from_pydantic
key_functions.purpose: Build TypeSpec from Pydantic model fields

key_functions.name: validate_match
key_functions.purpose: Check if a DataFrame conforms to a TypeSpec (returns bool)

key_functions.name: typespec_from_frictionless
key_functions.purpose: Import TypeSpec from Frictionless Table Schema dict

key_functions.name: compare_specs
key_functions.purpose: Diff two TypeSpecs to find added/removed/changed fields

extension_points: UniversalType enum for new type mappings
lifecycle_notes: DataResource.table_schema stores raw Frictionless dict for lossless round-trip (lazy TypeSpec conversion)
fieldsMatch defaults to 'exact' per Frictionless spec (2026-05)
Frictionless structural fidelity principle: TypeSpec mirrors Table Schema flat field layout
risks: UniversalType additions must be wired to all backend converters

evidence.detail: UniversalType enum with backend mapping methods
